_note: Info brokers sell tips about other destinations. reliability (hidden from the player) is the chance a tip reflects the real market; otherwise it is stale or invented. noise is the typical price error of a true tip. coverage lists places the broker hears about ('all' for everywhere). Tips expire after tip_ttl_days. Templates: {good} {place} {price} {broker}.

maisie_tran.name: Maisie Tran
maisie_tran.style: Retired Compact customs clerk. Still drinks with the dock crews, still hears everything near Earth.
short: "{place} is crying out for {good}, love. Paying about {price} a tonne, last I heard."
"Word from the {place} crews: {good} at {price} and nobody's bringing it."
glut: "Don't haul {good} to {place}. They're drowning in it. Could pick it up there for {price}, though."

lamplighter.name: Lamplighter
lamplighter.style: An unregistered AI living in the depot's traffic computer. Sells what it overhears on every channel. Polite. Expensive.
short: LAMPLIGHTER: {place} manifests show {good} demand unmet. Indicative bid {price} cr/t. This message will not be repeated.
LAMPLIGHTER: Three captains asked {place} for {good} today and were refused. Bid {price}.
glut: LAMPLIGHTER: {place} storage of {good} is near capacity. Indicative ask {price} cr/t.

dusty_okafor.name: Dusty Okafor
dusty_okafor.style: Prospector turned rumour merchant. Wildly enthusiastic. Right about half the time, and cheap with it.
short: "Mate. MATE. {good} at {place}. {price} a tonne! Trust me!"
"Heard it from a rover driver who heard it from a pilot: {place} wants {good}. {price}, easy."
glut: "Whatever you do, don't take {good} to {place}. Unless you're buying. {price}, they're giving it away."

auntie_vell.name: Auntie Vell
auntie_vell.style: Runs the Kernel's noodle bar and its gossip network. Knows what the settlers need before they do.
short: "The Yards folk were in last night moaning about {good}. {place}'s paying {price}, they said."
"Between us? {place} is short of {good}. {price} a tonne. Eat something, you look thin."
glut: "{place} has more {good} than it knows what to do with. You'd get it for {price}."
